title: After the Japanese Derby: No Plan is the Best Plan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't think! Close your eyes! Just go all out! I've got thiiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: HAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaah, let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer sprints down the track using only her heart as her compass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer! I won! I cleared my mind, and I got first!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I wasn't able to do it no matter how hard I tried back when I thought I had to take everything super seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But after meeting my bestie and learning how to goof off and live it up, I've… I've…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! I'm such an idiot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, can I be any more awkward? I swear… Ahahaha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I praise Mejiro Palmer as she laughs through tears. Even if it wasn't the victory she envisioned, it's a commendable victory all the same.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Here I thought Ines Fujin would run away with the win…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I was sure Mejiro Ryan would be the winner…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? I guess some people are shook that a rando like me won.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't say you're a "rando," though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That was impressive, Palmer. You did so well, I think you deserve a special treat!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So lemme give you an exclusive cheer! To be honest, I was really hoping to be the one receiving cheers, but it is what it is.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, here I go! Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ines… Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You too, Ryan? Everyone…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Thanks! Your cheering might not end up in Umamusume history…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I'll remember this forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, the four of us have a little party to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. ☆ If I run the way Ines did today…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And my bestie slays the getaway…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing. An idea just hit me, and I was tryna work it out! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's a pretty god-tier plan, but it could also be a total bust! ♪ But enough of that. C'mon, let's keep the party going!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let me just shake up this can of soda… ☆ Pop the tab…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Drop in a couple of Menthos candies and! ★★★ Woohooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa, holy crap! Girl, the soda's spraying everywhere! Omigo—pffft!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their bubbly after-party to celebrate the Derby lasts long into the night.
